subject: Renewal discussion: request for staged credits + price hold
messages:
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@hydronix.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Chen <mark.chen@hydronix.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal request + ask for conditional credits and a 12-month price hold

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Hydronix is preparing our renewal request and a short summary is attached (Hydronix_Renewal_Request_2028.xlsx). Key items:

- Current term ends 2028-07-31. We want a 12-month renewal with the option to increase committed capacity in Q4.
- Request: a one-year price hold on current unit rates for any committed capacity signed by 2028-06-15.
- Conditional credits: if our usage ramps slower than forecast in the first 3 months, Hydronix is asking for an "accelerator credit" equal to 20% of billed overage for Q1 to be applied as account credit.
- We are prepared to increase committed GPU-hours by 30% if we can secure the price hold + the conditional credit mechanism.

Can Redwood confirm whether this is something you can support? If yes, please share a short term sheet and we can route to procurement and legal (cc’ing Mark). Happy to schedule a 30-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Alyssa Turner
Head of Platform Operations
Hydronix AI

[Attachment: Hydronix_Renewal_Request_2028.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@hydronix.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal request + ask for conditional credits and a 12-month price hold

Hi Alyssa —

Appreciate the clear summary and the attachment. We can absolutely work with a structure that balances a price hold with protections for Redwood given variability in ramp. Initial proposal from our side: 

- 12-month price hold on current committed unit rates if Hydronix signs the renewed commitment by 2028-06-15.
- Accelerator credit: Redwood can offer a one-time account credit equal to 15% of Q1 overage (applied as a credit invoice) if actual usage is below 60% of forecast in months 1–3. The credit is intended to defray ramp risk while aligning incentives.
- Commit increase: If Hydronix takes the +30% committed GPU-hours now, we can tier the effective discount: +30% commit => additional 7% off committed units.
- We propose a three-month "ramp window" (months 1–3) where burst capacity is available but billed at committed rates until the ramp evaluation.

I'll draft a short term sheet (one-pager) and loop in Monica/Ben for pricing confirmation. Two asks from us: (1) we need a short usage forecast (daily/weekly expected hour profile) in the attached spreadsheet, and (2) procurement/legal will want to see the final payment and true-up cadence.

Would you be available for a 30-minute call on Thursday 2028-05-10 at 10am PT?

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue (Americas)
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redwood_Renewal_Term_Sheet_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Mark Chen <mark.chen@hydronix.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@hydronix.ai>
Cc: Sarah Blake <sarah@proteanlegal.com>
Date: 2028-05-09T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal request + ask for conditional credits and a 12-month price hold

Vivek —

Thanks for the quick reply and the draft term sheet. A couple of points from procurement/legal: 

- The 15% accelerator credit is a good start, but Hydronix would prefer 20% and have it applied pro-rata across the first two invoices rather than as a single credit line. This helps finance forecast cash flow.
- Can we get a firm guarantee that the price hold extends to reserved/dedicated capacity SKUs? Our ML workloads will likely move from hosted to dedicated over the next 6–9 months.

CC’ing Sarah from legal to flag any T&Cs that would block the proposed credit flow.

If it helps, we can accept a conditional cap on total credits equal to 10% of the first-year committed spend.

—Mark
Procurement, Hydronix AI

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-10T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: internal: Hydronix counter and recommended concession framing

Vivek / Ben —

Quick internal note after the call with Alyssa/Mark: Hydronix is sensitive to cash-flow forecasting, so moving the 20% as two pro-rata credits makes sense to them. Proposed counter we should offer (keeps economics neutral for Redwood while increasing chance of close):

- Keep the 12-month price hold for committed units (sign by 2028-06-15). Applies to hosted and dedicated SKUs (explicitly call out Dedicated).
- Accelerator credit: 18% of Q1 overage, split across invoices 1 and 2 (max exposure cap = 10% of first-year committed spend).
- Introduce a ramp milestone: if Hydronix hits >=75% of forecast by month 2, the accelerator credit is void (i.e., accelerates to normal true-up). This gives them motivation to hit cadence and reduces Redwood downside.
- For the +30% commit, keep the incremental 7% discount but require the new commit be contracted for 12 months from signing.

I drafted language for the term sheet (attached inline). If you approve, Vivek, we can send a revised term sheet to Alyssa + Mark and include a short DocuSign link for signatures.

Monica
Director, Customer Success 
Redwood Inference

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sarah Blake <sarah@proteanlegal.com>
Date: 2028-05-12T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final term summary and next steps (Hydronix renewal)

Alyssa / Mark —

Thanks for the constructive negotiation. Below is the agreed summary for the renewal offer; we can roll this into a final term sheet and send via DocuSign once you confirm: 

1) Term & Price Hold
- 12-month renewal starting on the signed effective date. Price hold on existing committed unit rates for 12 months provided the renewal is signed by 2028-06-15. Applies to both Hosted and Dedicated capacity SKUs.

2) Commit uplift and discount
- Hydronix will increase committed GPU-hours by +30% as part of this renewal. The incremental commit receives an additional 7% discount off committed unit rates for the 12-month term. The new commit is contracted for 12 months from signing.

3) Accelerator credit (ramp protection)
- If Hydronix actual usage is below 60% of forecast in months 1–3, Redwood will apply an accelerator credit equal to 18% of Q1 billed overage, split across invoices 1 and 2. Total credit exposure capped at 10% of first-year committed spend.
- If Hydronix hits >=75% of forecast by month 2, accelerator credit is voided.

4) Operational items
- Hydronix to provide the detailed usage forecast (daily/weekly) in the attached spreadsheet.
- True-up cadence: quarterly true-ups with invoice adjustments applied in the following invoice cycle.

Next steps:
- We will produce a one-page term sheet reflecting the bullets above and route via DocuSign (link below). Please confirm by end-of-day 2028-05-14 to keep the 2028-06-15 signature milestone.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/abc123-term-sheet
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

Thanks — looking forward to keeping Hydronix on a predictable cost path while supporting your growth.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue (Americas)
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redwood_Renewal_Term_Sheet_v1.pdf (pdf)]
